scope: Authority, provenance and lifecycle incident boxes, their expanded details, and section subtitles in the main article and three standalone governance pages.

findings_and_changes.finding: At 320px the standalone lifecycle track content used only 165px because of nested card padding and the marker gutter.
findings_and_changes.change: Remove outer side padding on narrow standalone lens panels. Keep lifecycle markers beside their headings and let states and conditions span the card.
findings_and_changes.current_measurement: State panels now use 247px at 320px in both the main article and standalone lifecycle page.

findings_and_changes.finding: Current and possible-next states needed clearer separation when stacked.
findings_and_changes.change: Add a divider between the two mobile state blocks. Preserve explicit replacement labelling for the expired immutable Context View.

findings_and_changes.finding: Lifecycle condition text was smaller than the body text of the other two incident boxes.
findings_and_changes.change: Use the same 14px body size; retain distinct styles for headings, record labels and supporting details.

findings_and_changes.finding: Accepted and admitted could be read as different definition states, and future effects needed clearer wording.
findings_and_changes.change: Show accepted (admitted) in both authority and lifecycle; label each conditional state effect Effect if completed. Describe the four lifecycle tracks as parallel.

findings_and_changes.finding: The provenance box relied on the preceding box for its incident context.
findings_and_changes.change: Name the shared ticket and connect the trail to the comparison permitted by the authority records.

browser.transport: Local HTTP serving the current file bundle
browser.cache: Disabled for final verification to prevent stale HTML or shared CSS

axe.scope: Expanded incident boxes only; WCAG 2 A/AA and 2.1 AA tagged rules
axe.manual_resolution: Inspected rendered markers and their computed foreground/opaque card background. All marker contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1.

boundary: Viewport and native interaction evidence from Chromium. This review does not establish comprehension for all readers or behavior in other browser engines.
